### Problem

The release lane takes about four hours per release because the scenarios play one at a time, so fixes reach the repositories late and the organisation's runners are not used.

### Scope

`.github/workflows/release-lane.yml` (the scenarios job split into move, play and back), `scripts/release-scenarios.py` (the groups, merging the results of every play job), `tests/release/scenarios.yml` (the key that marks a serial scenario), their tests, and docs/versioning.md.

### Out of scope

The timeout and the silent failure, which #690 fixes. Changing what any scenario checks.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given the release lane's workflow, when the scenarios play, then each group runs in a job of its own on `DX_RUNNER_HEAVY` (or `ubuntu-latest` when it is not set), all at once, after the callers moved and before they move back.
C2: Given `tests/release/scenarios.yml`, when `release-scenarios.py coverage` runs, then it fails for a scenario in no group or in two, and the scenarios marked serial are in one group that plays them one after the other.
C3: Given every play job finished, when the lane decides, then it reads one table with every scenario's result, and a play job that failed or timed out is a failing row, so nothing is tagged.

### Criticality

Normal
